title: To-do list
goal: Turn the page into a to-do list. The page has a text input with the placeholder "New task", a button labelled "Add", and a list of the stored tasks below them. Tasks are stored on the server as `Task` nodes connected to root, each with a field `title: str`. Clicking Add stores a new task with the typed title and shows it in the list. Tasks that are already stored are shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
